Bihar Weather Update : bihar men mausam ka mijaj badalne laga hai. patna samet 19 jilon men ghane kohre ko lekar yelo alart jari kiya gaya hai. samastipur aur begusray men subah ke samay ghana kohra dekhne ko mila. mausam vibhag ke anusar, aane vale dinon men subah aur rat ke vakt thand barhne ke aasar hain. aise men sarak par saphar karne vale log savdhani barten aur mausam se juri apdet par najar banae rakhen.
Dekhie bihar ke mausam ka taja hal aur kin jilon men kohre ka alart jari kiya gaya hai.
